description_en: Queries information about contiguous Elastic IP Address (EIP) groups
description_zh: 调用DescribeEipSegment查询连续EIP组的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-eip-segment --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-001sdfg --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --segment-instance-id eipsg-2zett8ba055tbsxme0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEipSegment

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the **RequestId** as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the contiguous EIP group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 连续EIP组所属的地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the contiguous EIP group to query.

If you do not specify this parameter, information about all contiguous EIP groups in the specified region is returned
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的连续EIP组的实例ID。

未指定时，返回指定地域下所有连续EIP组的信息
parameters.name: segment_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: **1**
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**
parameters.name: page_size
